description: This file defines a REST API resource for managing external asset owners and related transfers within the Fineract financial platform. It includes endpoints for creating transfer requests, retrieving transfer data, and accessing journal entries, with a focus on external asset owner interactions.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnersApiResource
classes.description: REST controller for managing external asset owners and their transfer interactions, providing endpoints for creating transfer requests, retrieving transfer info, and journal entries.

methods.name: transferRequestWithLoanId
methods.description: Initiates a transfer request for a specific loan ID with a command parameter.

methods.name: transferRequestWithLoanExternalId
methods.description: Initiates a transfer request for a loan identified by an external ID.

methods.name: transferRequestWithId
methods.description: Initiates a transfer request for a specific internal ID.

methods.name: transferRequestWithExternalId
methods.description: Initiates a transfer request referenced by an external ID.

methods.name: getTransfers
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of transfer data filtered by optional identifiers.

methods.name: getActiveTransfer
methods.description: Retrieves data about the active transfer, if any, based on identifiers.

methods.name: getJournalEntriesOfTransfer
methods.description: Fetches journal entries related to a specific transfer.

methods.name: getJournalEntriesOfOwner
methods.description: Fetches journal entries for an owner specified by external ID.

methods.name: searchInvestorData
methods.description: Performs a search over investor transfer data based on criteria such as text or date ranges.
